title: From resonance to chaos: modulating spatiotemporal patterns through a synthetic optogenetic oscillator
authors: Park JH; Holló G; Schaerli Y
one_liner_zh: 该文研究合成光遗传振荡器在细菌中的时空模式调控，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Oscillations are a recurrent phenomenon in biological systems across scales, including circadian clocks, metabolic oscillations and embryonic genetic oscillators. Despite their fundamental significance in biology, deciphering core principles of biological oscillators is very challenging due to the multiscale complexity of genetic networks and the difficulty in perturbing organisms in vivo . In this study, we tackle this challenge by re-designing the well-characterised synthetic oscillator, known as “repressilator”, in Escherichia coli and controlling it using optogenetics, thus introducing the “optoscillator”. When we apply periodic light pulses, the optoscillator behaves as a forced oscillator. Bacterial colonies harboring synthetic oscillators manifest oscillations as spatial ring patterns. Leveraging this feature, we systematically investigate the number, intensity and sharpness of the rings under different regimes of light exposure. By integrating experimental approaches with mathematical modeling, we show that this simple oscillatory circuit can generate complex dynamics that, depending on the external periodic forcing, are transformed into distinct spatial patterns. We report the observation of synchronisation, resonance, undertone and period doubling. Furthermore, we present evidence supporting the existence of a chaotic regime. This work highlights the intricate spatiotemporal patterns accessible by synthetic oscillators and underscores the potential of our approach in understanding the underlying principles governing biological oscillations.
abstract_zh: 振荡是生物系统中跨尺度反复出现的现象，包括昼夜节律、代谢振荡和胚胎遗传振荡器。尽管它们在生物学中具有根本重要性，但由于遗传网络的多尺度复杂性以及体内扰动生物体的困难，解析生物振荡器的核心原理极具挑战性。在本研究中，我们通过重新设计大肠杆菌中特性明确的合成振荡器（称为“repressilator”），并利用光遗传学对其进行控制，从而引入“optoscillator”，以应对这一挑战。当我们施加周期性光脉冲时，optoscillator表现为受迫振荡器。含有合成振荡器的细菌菌落以空间环状图案形式展现振荡。利用这一特性，我们系统研究了不同光照条件下环的数量、强度和锐度。通过将实验方法与数学建模相结合，我们表明这一简单的振荡电路能够产生复杂动力学，这些动力学根据外部周期性强迫被转化为不同的空间图案。我们报告了同步、共振、低音和周期倍增的观察结果。此外，我们提供了支持混沌区域存在的证据。这项工作突显了合成振荡器可实现的复杂时空图案，并强调了我们的方法在理解控制生物振荡的基本原理方面的潜力。
